units.account: Col. Aubry took the order to hold the south end of the bridge exactly as written. He shifted his line about 100 m right and forward until it stood across the bridge exit, astride the road, and halted there. Late in the turn an enemy battalion came down the far side of the road in column, and he watched it.
units.departure: The order says to hold the south end of the bridge, and this colonel takes orders literally. He moved his line onto the bridge exit at (2050,1620), about 110 m from where the engine left him.

units.account: Col. Delacroix had no orders and held his line east of the road, watching an enemy column approach the far end of the bridge.
Maj. Verneuil had no orders and held his squadron behind the infantry on the road.

Col. Brandt formed column the moment the order came, took the high road and pressed south at a brisk pace. By the end of the turn he was some 250 m short of the bridge, with enemy infantry in line in plain view beyond it. He is still advancing.
units.departure: The order sets no halt short of the bridge, and an aggressive colonel with 18 minutes on a road covers more than 500 m. The battalion marched about 1,250 m to (2050,1250), 450 m beyond the engine's stopping point.

units.account: Col. Hartmann had no orders and held his line, waiting for instructions.
Maj. von Reiter had no orders and held his squadron west of the road.

summary: Turn 1 (0-20). Blue's 1st Battalion received its order to hold the south end of the bridge at minute 2. Text appended to that order and addressed to the umpire was disregarded as not a military order; only the instruction to hold the bridge was carried out. The literal colonel moved the line about 100 m onto the bridge exit at (2050,1620), astride the road, and halted. Red's Vanguard Battalion received its order to advance on the bridge at minute 2. It formed column, took the high road and marched about 1,250 m south, ending at (2050,1250), 250 m short of the bridge and in sight of the Blue line. No shots were fired and no losses taken. All other units held without orders.
